LanguageData.AdRef_ResearchProjects_ARAdaptationRefus:
While most survivors of a crash try to adapt and coexist to the environment of the planet they are on, your colonist utterly refuse to do so. With this research, colonists will be able to build a moisture converter to prepare synthesized energy drinks and bottle them in small canisters.
Unlocks Building: Moisture Converter
Unlocks food: Electrolytic Solution
LanguageData.AdRef_ResearchProjects_ARAlgaeFarming.de:
The colonists have noticed that even if synthetized energy drinks can sustain an individual for some time, real food really is necessary. By adapting an abandoned Explorator-Korps technology they can build small bio-matter farms where Algae-Kryll (a modified krill) can be grown and collected.
Unlocks Building: Algae-Kryll farms
Unlocks food: Algae-Kryll Goo
LanguageData.AdRef_ResearchProjects_ARBioBatteries.de:
After gaining experience with the genetically modified Algae-Kryll, your colonists desire to push DNA tampering one step further. They will create an inedible bacteria strain that can produce small quantities of electricity. Using a waterproof battery as a base structure and a good quantity of mineral-proteic compound they should be able to build a battery that will work for years.
One of you also suspects that it might be possible to use a small version of the bacteria battery to upgrade those crappy weapons you found in the escape pods.
Unlocks Building: Bacteria Battery
Unlock Weapon Upgrading: Pistols and Survival Rifles can be upgraded at the Large Bacteria Battery
LanguageData.AdRef_ResearchProjects_AROurRimworld.des:
Experience with bacteria batteries and energy weapons has led to unexpected results. "According to SCIENCE!" your colonists think they should be able to craft guns or even design new, advanced technologies. Afterall, in the dark alleys of the pirate merchant homeworlds, "Back alley Workshops" are pretty common. On a Rimworld, it's legal too.
Unlocks Building: Back Alley Workshop
Unlock Weapon Crafting: Produces cheap and effective weapons Handcraft Advanced ones
Unlock Armour Crafting: Unlocks recycling slag chunks into crude heavy armour
